The answer names uses of MBEDTLS_PRIVATE in two top-level directories: `programs` (`programs/ssl/ssl_context_info.c`, `programs/fuzz/fuzz_dtlsserver.c`) and `include` (`ssl.h` and `psa/crypto_struct.h` under `include/mbedtls`).

The answer also names `library` for the `common.h` definition. That is a definition of `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS`, not a use of MBEDTLS_PRIVATE, so I left it out. `docs` is mentioned only as a reference to the migration guide, so I left that out too. `tests` appears only in the caveat about the test suites, so it is not listed either.

ITEMS:
programs
include
END
